source: const reviewOld={run(){}};const reviewClean={run(){}};const reviewBox={api:reviewOld};async function runReviewScenario(){const reviewInfo=await window.desktopApi.app.getInfo();do{if(reviewInfo.hasEnum)break;reviewBox.api=reviewClean;}while(false);const reviewOther=reviewBox.api;reviewOther.outsideScope=window.desktopApi.outsideScope;window.BankStatementController.createBankStatementController({api:reviewOld});return reviewOther===reviewOld;}runReviewScenario();
